get.description:
Route audit drawer (C-06, CR §4.6).

Evidence only — no metric is recomputed and no key is invented:

* ``routing_quality`` / ``distance_provider`` come from the stored report
  (the run that produced these routes); with no report they fall back to
  ``quality_for_provider`` on the circuity default, which is DEGRADED —
  never VERIFIED_GRAPH.
* ``solver`` is ``optimizer_name_for_audit()``, ``model_version`` the
  carbon evidence constant, both versions the manifest helpers.
* ``seed`` is ``None``: ``/optimize`` runs the deterministic heuristic and
  carries no seed, so there is no run seed to report (inventing one would
  be a fabricated provenance claim). ``dataset``-level provenance lives in
  ``/analytics/kpis``.
* ``created_at`` is the stored report's mtime — see ``_run_created_at``.

get.description: Place detail via GOFA (or mock fallback when no key configured).

KPI roll-up for the whole dataset (CR §4.2).

Metrics that cannot be measured from stored data are ``null`` (never 0) —
see ``metrics.py`` for the per-metric reason and its standard.

``service.late_orders`` is the *modelled* late-risk count from ``late.py``
(depot→stop ETA at 30 km/h vs ``window_end``), NOT a measured OTIF
numerator: no delivered-at timestamp is stored, which is why
``service.on_time`` and ``service.otif_pct`` are ``null``. Charts must label
it "modelled".

Bucketed series (CR §4.3). ``metric`` names the series of interest; the
payload keeps the frozen 5-metric point shape, ``otif_pct`` stays null
because no delivered-at timestamp is stored.
Per-vehicle km, fuel, CO2e, load and utilisation (CR §4.4).

ReportMetrics.title: ReportMetrics
ReportMetrics.description:
Standard-based metric dictionary carried by /report (C-04, CR §4.1).

Every formula comes from ``analytics.metrics`` — never re-implemented here.
The block describes the **optimized** plan; its denominators (orders,
delivered kg, capacity of the used vehicles) are the same DB aggregates
``/analytics/kpis`` publishes, so the two endpoints reconcile for one
dataset. ``None`` = not computable from stored data, never a fabricated
default.
